## Executive Summary

This pipeline ingests clinical RNA-seq data from the GDC, models differential
expression between Stage I and Stage IV tumors using `DESeq2`, and maps
significant biomarkers to their genomic coordinates. No batch-correction step
was applied in this analysis.

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

# Load the artifacts generated by the pipeline
dds <- readRDS("../data/luad_dds.rds")
sig_biomarkers <- readRDS("../data/sig_biomarkers.rds")
```

## Top Up-Regulated Biomarkers (Stage IV Drivers)

These genes show the strongest significant up-regulation in Stage IV relative
to Stage I in this cohort. Some top hits belong to the MAGE family of
cancer-testis antigens.

```{r top-biomarkers}
top_upregulated <- sort(
  sig_biomarkers[sig_biomarkers$log2FoldChange > 0],
  by = ~ log2FoldChange,
  decreasing = TRUE
)
top_five <- as.data.frame(head(top_upregulated, 5))
top_five <- top_five[
  ,
  intersect(
    c("seqnames", "start", "end", "gene_name", "log2FoldChange", "padj"),
    names(top_five)
  ),
  drop = FALSE
]
knitr::kable(top_five, digits = 3, caption = "Top five up-regulated biomarkers")
```

## Clinical Biomarker Heatmap

Unsupervised hierarchical clustering of patients based on normalized
expression Z-scores of the `r length(sig_biomarkers)` significant biomarkers.
The stage annotation shows whether the expression-based clusters align with
clinical stage.

```{r clinical-heatmap}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 8
source("../R/04_visualization.R")

ht <- plot_clinical_heatmap(
  dds_path = "../data/luad_dds.rds",
  sig_path = "../data/sig_biomarkers.rds"
)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht)
```
